verdict.rationale: Google endpoint management is built into the Workspace admin platform and covers mobile devices, desktops and laptops (docs-17). It is documented with mobile password policy enforcement (docs-9), wiping a user's account from a mobile device (docs-8), and API actions on lost domain devices (docs-23). Context-Aware Access ties app access to user identity plus device security status (docs-28), and community reports confirm Endpoint Verification is enforced in practice (comm-2, comm-4). missing for 10: explicit documentation of the device enrollment flow, explicit remote lock capability, depth of desktop/laptop policy controls, independent hands-on corroboration of wipe/lock.
